messages:
Jordan: quick heads-up — PR #9123 is ready from a code perspective but I didn't include the RFC link in the description. CI is green but per the repo rules this is gated on an architecture/design reference and an arch + SRE eyeball. Can someone please advise on the right RFC to cite and whether we need a canary window?
Sasha: can you paste the RFC draft link here? also call out any SLO/latency deltas in the PR description.
Jordan: sure — RFC draft is at https://rwd.internal/rfcs/1467 (multi-tenant routing + routing policy shim). short summary: adds routing-layer decision to split requests by tenant affinity, adds a small extra lookup hop and optional prefix cache. Expected median p99 token latency +4–6ms in our perf tests.
Alex: thanks. a couple quick asks from architecture: 1) add RFC link to PR description (exact heading: "RFC: <link>") 2) attach the canary plan (duration, traffic %, rollback criteria) 3) confirm fallback path if the routable caches miss (what model variant we fall back to).
Maria: runtime notes — this touches the request path header parsing and cache key derivation. I've run a 30m perf run on staging and saw a 3–5ms median increase; no memory growth. Canary should be fine but needs a 1h ramp to be safe.
devops-bot: build #9123/CI passed — all checks OK (:white_check_mark:)
Sasha: I can take architecture review. Jordan — can you update the PR with the RFC link, add a short canary section, and label the PR "arch-review"? I should be able to review by EOD PST.
Jordan: updated PR description: added "RFC: https://rwd.internal/rfcs/1467" and a canary section. added arch-review label and linked @Sasha. commit: https://git.internal/rwd/pr/9123/commit/4a5c3d2
Alex: quick look — overall I like it. please add one sentence to the RFC link section explaining fallback model variant (we revert to "model-v1-small" for non-affine requests). then I'm happy to +1.
Sasha: reading now. small nit: please include the exact SLA test run command in the PR so SRE can repro. otherwise :eyes:
Jordan: added fallback note and SLA repro command in the PR description. pinging for approvals.
Sasha: arch +1 from me after the tiny doc tweak — leaving formal approval in GitHub. :thumbsup:
Alex: arch acked in github, leaving comment with canary window suggestion (1h 10% -> 1h 50% -> 2h 100%).
Jordan: thanks all — scheduling merge for our next maintenance window (tomorrow 03:00 UTC). will monitor metrics and have quick rollback runbook in the PR.
Maria: I'll own the first 30m of monitoring after merge. ping me if anomalies.
Sasha: thanks — closing loop here.
Jordan: appreciate it — marking the thread resolved.
